name: io.github.spokenmd/spoken
title: Spoken
description: Podcast transcripts as clean Markdown with real speaker names — via the Spoken API.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by an API key from spoken.md (Bearer pt_...). Optional: without it only the free tools work, and a client that supports OAuth is asked to sign in.

environmentVariables.name: SPOKEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from spoken.md (starts with pt_). Defaults to pt_demo (search works fully; transcripts limited to the demo episode).
